towns.name: Santa María de Guía de Gran Canaria

paragraphs: Poco nuboso o despejado en general, con algunos intervalos nubosos en el norte a primeras y, sobre todo, a últimas horas del día, así como en zonas de interior por la tarde. Temperaturas máximas sin cambios o en ligero ascenso. Mínimas en ligero ascenso en zonas bajas y en moderado ascenso en medianías y cumbres. Viento flojo a moderado del nordeste, más intenso en costas sudeste y noroeste.

Little cloudy or clear in general, with some cloudy intervals in the north to the first and, above all, late in the day, as well as in interior areas in the afternoon. Maximum temperatures unchanged or slightly rising. Minor ascents in low and moderately rising areas in medium altitude areas and peaks. Light wind to moderate north-east, more intense on south-east and northwest coasts.

paragraphs: En el noreste, intervalos nubosos con baja probabilidad de alguna lluvia débil. En el resto, poco nuboso con intervalos de nubes altas. Temperaturas con pocos cambios. Viento moderado de nordeste a este, con intervalos de mayor intensidad en las vertientes sudeste y noroeste. Brisas en costas del suroeste.

In the northeast, cloudy intervals with low probability of some weak rain. In the rest, little cloudy with high cloud intervals. Temperatures with few changes. Moderate wind from north-east to east, with intervals of greater intensity in the south-east and northwest slopes. Brisas on the southwest coast.

paragraphs: Poco nuboso en general, salvo intervalos nubosos en las vertientes este de las islas durante la primera mitad del día, así como en zonas de interior durante la tarde. No se descarta calima en altura en las islas occidentales en la segunda mitad del día. Temperaturas sin cambios o en ligero ascenso. Viento flojo a moderado de componente este, que girará a moderado de componente oeste en cumbres por la tarde.

Little cloudy in general, except for cloudy intervals on the eastern slopes of the islands during the first half of the day, as well as in interior areas during the afternoon. Atmospheric dust suspended in height on the western islands in the second half of the day is not ruled out. Temperatures unchanged or slightly rising. Light wind to moderate east component, which will rotate to moderate west component at peaks in the afternoon.

paragraphs: Poco nuboso en general, con intervalos nubosos en zonas de interior durante la tarde, así como en vertientes norte al final del día. No se descarta calima en altura en las islas occidentales. Temperaturas con pocos cambios. Viento flojo con predominio de la componente este durante la primera mitad del día, y de la componente norte durante la segunda.

Little cloudy in general, with cloudy intervals in interior areas during the afternoon, as well as in northern slopes at the end of the day. Atmospheric dust suspended in height on the western islands is not ruled out. Temperatures with few changes. light wind with predominance of the eastern component during the first half of the day, and of the northern component during the second.
